---
title: "nondeterminism"
description: "A handler read the clock or randomness directly (Date.now, new Date(), Math.random, crypto.randomUUID, ...)."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** A handler read the clock or randomness directly (Date.now, new Date(), Math.random, crypto.randomUUID, ...).

**How to fix it:** Use `ctx.now()`, `ctx.random()` or `ctx.id()`: they are recorded in the journal, so replay reproduces them.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
